components.css: .field-map{width:min(330px,calc(100% - 30px));padding:16px;background:#fff9e8;border-radius:8px;color:#4c6044;box-shadow:0 8px 30px #28412b30;font-family:"DM Sans",sans-serif}.field-map-toggle{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:5px;width:100%;min-height:34px;background:transparent;border:0;padding:0;color:var(--camp-ink,#243e32);text-align:left;font-size:13px;transition:background .15s,color .15s}.field-map-toggle b{font-size:13px}.field-map-toggle:hover:not(:disabled){filter:brightness(.96)}.field-map-toggle:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #ac823e;outline-offset:4px}.map-paper{height:170px;position:relative;margin-top:12px;background:#e2dfbf;border-radius:5px}.map-paper>span{position:absolute;font-size:12px;background:#d5dfbc;color:var(--camp-ink,#243e32);border-radius:50%;width:24px;height:24px;text-align:center;line-height:24px;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);font-weight:700}.map-paper i{position:absolute;width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:#b4763e;outline:2px solid #fff6d6;transform:translate(-50%,-50%)}.field-map-legend{display:grid;gap:8px;margin-top:15px;font-size:12px;color:var(--camp-ink,#243e32)}.field-map-legend>div{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px}.field-map-legend>div>b{display:grid;place-items:center;width:22px;height:22px;font-size:12px;background:#d5dfbc;border-radius:50%}.field-map-legend p{font-size:11px;line-height:1.5;margin:5px 0 0}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.field-map-toggle{transition:none}}.field-map.is-open{max-height:calc(100% - 30px);overflow:auto;touch-action:pan-y}.map-paper{overflow:hidden}.map-paper>svg{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%}.map-view-tabs{display:flex;gap:6px;margin:8px 0}.map-view-tabs button{flex:1;border:1px solid #a8b58d;background:transparent;border-radius:6px;padding:7px;color:#243e32;font-size:12px}.map-view-tabs button[aria-pressed=true]{background:#243e32;color:#fff9e8}.map-view-tabs button:hover{filter:brightness(.96)}.map-view-tabs button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #ac823e;outline-offset:4px}.field-map-legend{gap:6px}@media(max-width:600px){.field-map.is-open .map-paper{height:150px}}

narrative.overview: Trilha extends its established forest-and-cream identity into a shared virtual camp. Dark green typography, warm paper surfaces, leaf-toned selections and occasional gold details support approachable Portuguese interactions. The map is immersive while the surrounding interface uses restrained tonal separation. This records source inspection, without a new creative metaphor or browser verification. The exploration extension preserves the forest world and cream interface across five trails, six outer destinations and twelve local discoveries. A region/camp atlas orients the player; collection cards reveal stories as discoveries are found. Source restores the latest same-room position on return to the scene; this is not persistent multi-room pose history.

rules.name: The Forest and Paper Rule
rules.body: Extend the incumbent greens and cream surfaces when adding interface regions; preserve the Trilha identity established in PRODUCT.md.

dos: Do preserve the Trilha forest and cream identity and Portuguese labels.
Do reuse the action hierarchy and visible keyboard focus.
Do preserve circular portraits and player identification.
Do retain responsive navigation, map fullscreen and reduced-motion support.
donts: Don't introduce an unrelated visual identity while extending this lobby.
Don't present disabled payment preparation as an active purchase.
Don't imply source extraction verifies browser rendering or runtime capacity.
